test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On: 25 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In July 2021, Kiren Rijiju was made the Cabinet Minister and given the charge of which of the following ministries?

options.text: Ministry of Communication and Electronics and Information Technology

solution:
The correct option is __**Ministry of Law and Justice.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kiren Rijiju** is an Indian politician from Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• Rijiju was born on **19 November 1971** at** Nakhu**, **Arunachal Pradesh**.
 
• In July 2021, he was appointed as minister of Law and Justice in the cabinet of ministers.
 
• **In his political career he had worked as:**
 
 
• ​Minister of State for Youth Affairs and Sports from 30 May 2019 – 7 July 2021.
 
• Minister of State for Minority Affairs from 30 May 2019 – 7 July 2021.
 
• Minister of State for Home Affairs from 26 May 2014 – 30 May 2019.
 
• Member of Parliament, Lok Sabha. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shri Jyotiraditya M. Scindia **serves as the minister of Civil Aviation.
 
• **Sarbanada Sonowal Ji** serves as the minister of Ports and Shipping.
 
• **Ashwini Vaishnaw** serves as the Cabinet Minister of Communication and Electronics and Information Technology.
